observations.name: delivery_report
observations.value: HCN GIAO NMR shielding calculation using PBE0/def2-TZVP RKS, charge 0, multiplicity 1, gas phase, on the prepared fixed initial geometry. Files: job.inp (actual input), hcn.xyz (initial/computational geometry), nmr_tensors.csv (machine-readable 3x3 tensors and isotropic values), nmr_summary.json (parsed summary and receipt metadata), observations.json. Seed 1701 is not applicable in this analysis script because no random numbers are used here.
